glosses.notes: 技巧 means a practical skill or technique that makes doing something easier or more effective.

examples.sentence: 老师说这道题前面看着很难，可是只要你抓住那个小技巧，后面很多地方一下就会变得比原来清楚得多。
母亲切东西的时候总有自己的技巧，所以同样一把刀到了她手里，不但快一点，做出来的样子也整齐很多。
经理后来提醒大家，说话的时候也得有一点技巧，不然前面明明想帮人，后面还是可能让人误会。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said this problem looks hard at first, but once you grasp that small skill, many parts later on suddenly become much clearer than before.
Mother always has her own technique when cutting things, so with the same knife in her hand, not only is she a little faster, but what she makes also looks much neater.
The manager later reminded everyone that speaking also requires some skill, or even when you clearly mean to help at first, people may still misunderstand later.

glosses.notes: 技艺 means skilled craft or artistry developed through long practice.

examples.sentence: 那位老人做这门技艺已经很多年了，所以孩子们一看见他手上的动作，就知道这些东西不是一下就能学会的。
老师带大家去看那场表演的时候说，真正让人佩服的不是声音有多大，而是后面藏着多少年一点一点练出来的技艺。
后来大家一边看一边才知道，这种技艺以前是怎么在老人手里一点一点留下来的。

example_translations.translation: That old man has practiced this craft for many years, so as soon as the children see the movements of his hands, they know these things cannot be learned all at once.
When the teacher took everyone to see that performance, she said that what truly deserves admiration is not how loud the sound is, but how many years of slowly practiced skill lie behind it.
Later, as everyone watched, they came to understand how this kind of artistry had once been preserved little by little in older people’s hands.

glosses.notes: 夹 means to press, pinch, or hold something between two sides.

examples.sentence: 门一关上，那张纸就被夹在中间了，所以孩子后来怎么拉都拉不出来，只好站在门口等母亲回来帮忙。
车上人一下多起来以后，父亲一直怕孩子的手被前面那扇门夹到，所以还没到站就先把他拉到了自己身边。
母亲把照片夹在书里以前，总会先看看里面那页是不是已经有字，不然过几天再打开的时候就不好看了。

example_translations.translation: When the door shut, the sheet of paper got pressed in the middle, so no matter how the child pulled later, he could not get it out and had to wait by the door for Mother to come back and help.

After the vehicle suddenly became crowded, Father kept worrying that the child’s hand might get squeezed by the door in front, so before they even reached the stop, he pulled the child to his side first.
Before slipping a photo into a book, Mother always first checks whether that page already has writing on it, or it will not look good when it is opened again a few days later.

glosses.notes: 加倍 means doubling something or doing it with twice the amount or effort.

examples.sentence: 医生说前面这几天只要没有新的问题，后面吃药的量就不用加倍，所以父亲一听见这句话，心里马上轻松了很多。
经理看见客人越来越多以后，先把门口的人手加倍，不是因为里面已经乱了，而是怕后面一下进来太多人会更难管。
孩子这次没有考好以后，自己反而决定把练习时间加倍，因为他说前面已经错过一次了，后面不想再用同样的理由安慰自己。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that as long as no new problem appeared in the next few days, the amount of medicine later would not need to be doubled, and Father felt much lighter the moment he heard that.

After seeing more and more customers arrive, the manager first doubled the number of people at the entrance, not because the inside had already grown chaotic, but because he feared it would be harder to manage if too many came in at once later.

After not doing well this time, the child instead decided to double his practice time, because he said he had already missed one chance earlier and did not want to comfort himself later with the same excuse.

glosses.notes: 家常 refers to ordinary matters of daily family life, often in conversation.

examples.sentence: 老人一坐下来就爱跟大家说家常，所以原来只是来送东西的人，后来也常常会在门口多站一会儿再走。
老师让孩子写作文的时候说，别总想着写太远的事，其实把家常写清楚，也一样能让看的人一下想起自己的生活。
节目里最打动人的地方不是谁说了大道理，而是母亲后来和孩子慢慢说家常的时候，那种很平常又很真的样子。

example_translations.translation: Once the old man sits down, he loves talking about everyday family life, so even people who originally came only to drop something off often stay at the door a little longer before leaving.

When the teacher had the children write essays, she said they should not always think about writing about distant things, because writing everyday family life clearly can also make readers suddenly think of their own lives.

The most moving part of the program was not that anyone spoke about grand principles, but the moment later when the mother slowly talked with the child about ordinary family matters in a way that felt both plain and real.

glosses.notes: 家家户户 means every household across a place or community.

examples.sentence: 冬天雪很大，所以村里家家户户门口都先把路上的雪收拾干净，不然一到晚上，老人和孩子出门都不方便。
节目前面一说起那段日子，很多人就想起家家户户晚上一起坐在门口乘凉的时候，因为那时候谁家有事大家都会先知道。
这条新消息一传开，城里家家户户都开始看后面会不会真有变化，因为前面已经有人等了很久，也听过太多次同样的话。

example_translations.translation: In winter, when the snow is heavy, every household in the village first clears the snow from the road by the door, or once night comes, it becomes inconvenient for older people and children to go out.

As soon as the program brought up those days, many people remembered how every household used to sit outside at night to enjoy the cool air together, because back then everyone would know first if something happened in any home.

Once this new piece of news spread, every household in the city began watching to see whether real change would follow, because many had already waited a long time and had heard the same kind of words too many times before.

glosses.notes: 加剧 means making a problem, feeling, or conflict stronger or more serious.

examples.sentence: 医生说如果前面一直不休息，后面肩膀的痛就可能继续加剧，所以父亲虽然还有事没做完，也只好先停下来。
经理后来发现，前面那点小误会之所以会加剧，不是因为事情本身多大，而是大家一直都没有把最重要的那句话说清楚。
天气一变，河边那片路的危险就会加剧，所以导游每次带人过去以前，都会先看看前面那块地方是不是已经有水了。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that if he kept going without rest, the pain in his shoulder might continue to intensify later, so although Father still had unfinished work, he had no choice but to stop first.

The manager later discovered that the reason that small misunderstanding had grown worse was not that the matter itself was very large, but that everyone had failed to make the most important sentence clear.
Once the weather changes, the danger on that stretch by the river intensifies, so every time before taking people there, the guide first checks whether water has already reached the area ahead.

glosses.notes: 家居 refers to home-related furnishings, goods, or living style.

examples.sentence: 这家店前面看着不大，可是里面卖的家居用品很全，所以很多人搬家以前都会先过来看看还缺什么。
母亲最近一直在看家居方面的书，不是因为突然想买很多新东西，而是想把现在这个小地方收拾得更方便一点。
节目后来介绍那位老人以前怎么自己做家居小东西时，很多年轻人一边看一边才发现，原来好看和实用也能放在一起。

example_translations.translation: This shop does not look big from the outside, but it carries a full range of home furnishings, so many people stop by before moving to see what they still need.
Mother has been reading books on home living lately, not because she suddenly wants to buy a lot of new things, but because she wants to make this small place more convenient.
When the program later showed how that older man used to make small home items by hand, many younger viewers gradually realized that beauty and practicality can go together.

glosses.notes: 家属 means a family member, especially in hospitals, schools, work units, or official settings.

examples.sentence: 护士后来提醒家属，病人刚睡着的时候最好先别一下进去太多人，不然前面好不容易安静下来，后面又会被吵醒。
学校通知开会的时候特别写清楚了，希望家属按时到，因为前面有几个地方要一起说明，不然回去以后很容易再问第二次。
那位老人前面一直不肯住院，后来还是家属一边陪着说，一边把后面的安排都准备好，他才慢慢愿意进去检查。

example_translations.translation: The nurse later reminded the family members that once the patient had just fallen asleep, it was best not to have too many people go in at once, or after finally calming down earlier, he might be woken again later.

When the school sent out the meeting notice, it stated clearly that family members were expected to arrive on time, because several points needed to be explained together first, or after going home it would be easy to ask again a second time.

That older person had long refused to be hospitalized, but later, as family members stayed beside him talking and preparing the later arrangements, he slowly became willing to go in for an examination.

glosses.notes: 加以 is a formal word often used before verbs like 说明, 处理, or 改进 to mean applying action to something.

examples.sentence: 老师说这几个地方如果不加以处理，后面读的人很可能会看错意思，所以前面还是得多写一点。
经理后来把最容易出问题的那一步单独拿出来加以处理，不是因为前面的努力没有用，而是因为大家都看见那里确实最容易再错。
医生看完前面的检查以后说，这种情况还得加以观察几天，因为现在虽然没有明显变化，可是后面也不能太早放心。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that if these points were not properly dealt with, later readers would likely misunderstand the meaning, so the beginning still needs a little more explanation.

The manager later singled out the step most likely to cause trouble and dealt with it separately, not because the earlier effort had been useless, but because everyone could see that it was indeed the place most likely to go wrong again.

After reviewing the earlier examination, the doctor said that this situation still needed to be observed for a few more days, because although there was no obvious change now, it was still too early to relax later on.

glosses.notes: 家园 means one’s home place or homeland, especially as a shared place to protect or rebuild.

examples.sentence: 那场大雨过去以后，很多人站在原地看了很久，因为眼前这个地方不只是房子和路，也是他们一点一点过出来的家园。
老师说保护这个地方不是一句好听的话，而是真的要让后面的人还有机会看见，这片家园以前为什么值得大家一直留下来。
电影最后最打动人的地方，不是有人说自己多勇敢，而是那些本来打算离开的人，后来还是决定回去把家园一点一点收拾好。

example_translations.translation: After the heavy rain had passed, many people stood there looking for a long time, because the place before their eyes was not only houses and roads, but also the homeland they had built little by little through life.

The teacher said that protecting this place is not merely a fine-sounding phrase, but truly making sure that later people still have a chance to see why this homeland had always been worth staying for.

The most moving part at the end of the film was not that anyone said how brave they were, but that the people who had originally planned to leave later decided to go back and slowly put their homeland in order again.

glosses.notes: 加重 means making a burden, illness, pressure, or weight heavier or more serious.

examples.sentence: 医生提醒父亲，这几天如果还是像以前那样一直不休息，很可能会加重前面的痛，所以后面就更难好起来。
经理说现在最怕的不是问题本身，而是大家一句话都不说，那样只会把原来不大的误会一点一点加重。
老人本来就睡得不好，如果晚上门口一直有声音，前面的疲劳只会继续加重，所以母亲才一直劝大家先小声一点。

example_translations.translation: The doctor reminded Father that if he still kept going without rest as before in the next few days, it would very likely aggravate the earlier pain, and then it would be even harder to recover later.

The manager said that what he feared most now was not the problem itself, but everyone saying nothing at all, because that would only make what had not been a large misunderstanding little by little more serious.

The older man already slept badly, so if there were constant noise at the door at night, the earlier fatigue would only keep worsening, which was why Mother kept urging everyone to speak a little more quietly first.

glosses.notes: 假设 can mean supposing something for the sake of thinking it through, or it can mean a hypothesis.

examples.sentence: 老师说你先假设自己就是那天站在门口的人，再想一想前面那些话为什么会让后面的人一下变得那么生气。
医生看完检查以后没有马上下结论，而是先提出一个假设，让大家回去以后再看后面几天是不是会出现同样的情况。
经理后来提醒大家，开会时可以先假设最坏的情况，不是因为一定会那样，而是因为这样做后面才不会一下手忙脚乱。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that you should first suppose you were the person standing at the entrance that day, and then think about why those earlier words made the people later on suddenly become so angry.

After examining the results, the doctor did not draw a conclusion immediately, but first proposed a hypothesis and asked everyone to see over the next few days whether the same condition would appear again.

The manager later reminded everyone that in meetings they may first suppose the worst case, not because it will certainly happen that way, but because doing so keeps people from becoming chaotic all at once later.

glosses.notes: 嫁 means for a woman to marry, often with attention to the family and place she marries into.

examples.sentence: 母亲说自己年轻时从来没想过会嫁到这么远的地方，可是后来真的过来以后，还是一点一点把这里也活成了家。
电影里那个女孩子明明知道后面的日子不会太轻松，可是她还是决定嫁过去，因为她觉得自己不能只听别人怎么说。
老人一说起女儿当年嫁出去的时候，脸上还是会慢慢有一点笑，因为前面虽然舍不得，可是后面看到她过得好也就放心了。

example_translations.translation: Mother said that when she was young she had never imagined she would marry into a place so far away, but after truly coming here later, she still turned it little by little into a home as well.
In the film, that young woman clearly knew that life later would not be very easy, yet she still decided to marry there, because she felt she could not only listen to what other people said.

Whenever the older man speaks of the time his daughter married and left home, a slight smile still slowly appears on his face, because although it was hard to part earlier, seeing her live well later put him at ease.

glosses.notes: 尖 means sharp or pointed, and it can also refer to the tip of something.

examples.sentence: 孩子走得太快，母亲赶紧把他拉住，因为前面那块石头很尖，只要一不小心碰上去，脚上马上就会疼很久。
老师先让大家看那支笔前面有多尖，说真正难的不是把字写出来，而是每一笔都别一下写歪。
那座屋子的顶看起来有一点尖，所以外地来的孩子一下就记住了，因为他以前只在书上见过差不多的样子。

example_translations.translation: The child was walking too fast, and Mother quickly pulled him back because the stone ahead was very sharp, and if he accidentally hit it, his foot would hurt for a long time right away.
The teacher first had everyone look at how sharp the front of that pen was and said the real challenge is not getting the character onto the page, but keeping each stroke from going crooked.
The top of that house looked somewhat pointed, so the child from outside remembered it at once, because before that he had seen only a similar shape in books.

glosses.notes: 肩膀 means the shoulder, often in contexts of carrying, pain, comfort, or support.

examples.sentence: 父亲前面搬东西的时候一直没觉得什么，后来晚上坐下来以后才发现肩膀越来越疼，所以第二天一早就先去医院看了。
孩子困得不行的时候，总爱把头一下靠在母亲肩膀上，所以每次车还没到站，母亲就已经知道后面多半要抱着他下去了。
医生说前面那几天先别让肩膀太用力，不是因为问题很大，而是因为只要现在再伤一次，后面恢复就会慢很多。

example_translations.translation: Father did not feel much while moving things earlier, but after sitting down that night he found his shoulder hurting more and more, so early the next morning he went to the hospital first.

When the child is extremely sleepy, he always likes to rest his head at once on Mother’s shoulder, so before the vehicle even reaches the stop, she already knows she will probably have to carry him down later.
The doctor said not to put too much strain on the shoulder in the next few days, not because the problem is huge, but because if it is hurt again now, recovery later will be much slower.

glosses.notes: 监测 means monitoring something by checking or measuring it over time.

examples.sentence: 工作人员这几天一直在河边监测水的变化，因为前面已经下了很久的雨，谁也不敢说后面一定不会再出问题。
医生让父亲回家以后继续监测那几个数字，不是因为现在已经很危险，而是因为后面如果有变化，最好能先看出来。
学校后来在门口加了新的东西来监测进出的人数，因为前面几次活动人太多，大家都觉得再不看紧一点会更乱。

example_translations.translation: The staff have been monitoring changes in the river these past few days, because it has already rained for a long time earlier and no one dares say that nothing will go wrong later.
The doctor told Father to keep monitoring those numbers after going home, not because things were already very dangerous, but because if changes came later, it would be best to notice them early.

The school later added something new at the entrance to monitor the number of people going in and out, because at the previous few events there had been too many people, and everyone felt that without closer watch things would grow even more disorderly.

glosses.notes: 坚定 means firm or steadfast, and it can also mean making belief or resolve stronger.

examples.sentence: 她前面虽然也有一点怕，可是一开口的时候声音还是很坚定，所以连原来一直不太相信她的人后来也安静下来了。
老师说真正难得的是，后面有难的时候，心里想继续走下去的想法还一样坚定。
母亲没有一下替孩子把问题都解决，而是先让他自己想，再在后面慢慢加一点话，好把他的意思一点一点坚定下来。

example_translations.translation: Although she had been somewhat afraid earlier, her voice was still very firm when she began speaking, so even the people who had not really believed her at first later quieted down.
The teacher said that what is truly admirable is that when difficulties come later, the desire in one’s heart to keep going remains just as steadfast.
Mother did not solve all the child’s problems at once for him, but first let him think for himself and then slowly added a few words later, helping to strengthen his thinking bit by bit.

glosses.notes: 监督 means supervising, watching, or overseeing to make sure something is done properly.

examples.sentence: 经理后来安排一个人在门口专门监督大家进出的顺序，因为前面已经乱过一次，谁也不想让同样的问题后面再来一遍。
老师说写完以后最好先找别人监督自己再看一遍，不然前面明明漏了好几个地方，后面还是很容易一下就交上去。
家里修房子那几天，父亲每天都过去监督，不是怕别人不认真，而是因为前面很多地方只有他自己最清楚应该怎么做。

example_translations.translation: The manager later arranged for one person to stand at the entrance and supervise the order in which people went in and out, because things had already become chaotic once earlier and no one wanted the same problem to come again later.

The teacher said that after finishing, it is best to have someone else supervise you while checking it once more, or even if several points were clearly missed earlier, it remains easy to hand it in at once later on.

During the days when the family house was being repaired, Father went over every day to supervise, not because he feared others were not serious, but because he himself knew best how many of the earlier parts should be done.

glosses.notes: 坚固 means physically solid, strong, and not easy to break or move.

examples.sentence: 这座旧桥看着没有前面那座新，可是下面那几排石头一直很坚固，所以这么多年过去了，还是天天有人从上面走。
老师让孩子们先摸一摸那面墙，再自己想为什么它会这么坚固，因为如果只听解释，很多人一下还是记不住。
这个东西外面看着普通，可是里面做得很坚固，所以父亲每次去外地以前都喜欢用它装最重要的东西。

example_translations.translation: This old bridge does not look as new as the one ahead, but the rows of stones beneath it have remained very solid, so even after all these years people still walk across it every day.

The teacher had the children first touch that wall and then think for themselves about why it was so strong, because if they only listened to an explanation, many would still fail to remember it right away.
This thing looks ordinary on the outside, but the inside is made very solidly, so every time before Father goes away, he likes using it to pack the most important things.

glosses.notes: 坚决 means firm and determined, with no intention of giving in easily.

examples.sentence: 母亲前面听完那件事以后态度很坚决，她说现在如果不把话说清楚，后面同样的问题还会再来。
老师后来一看见那个孩子又想放弃，就很坚决地让他先坐下来，把前面已经做对的地方重新看一遍，再决定后面怎么办。
经理说这次处理问题一定要坚决一点，不是因为想给谁难看，而是因为前面已经有人吃过亏，后面不能再让同样的事发生。

example_translations.translation: After hearing about that matter, Mother’s attitude was very resolute. She said that if things were not made clear now, the same problem would come back later.

Later, as soon as the teacher saw that child wanting to give up again, she firmly had him sit down first, look again through the parts he had already gotten right, and only then decide what to do later.

The manager said that this time the problem had to be handled more resolutely, not because he wanted to embarrass anyone, but because someone had already suffered earlier and the same thing could not be allowed to happen again later.

glosses.notes: 艰难 means difficult in a serious, demanding, or trying way.

examples.sentence: 那段日子前面过得很艰难，可是老人后来回头说，最难的还不是吃得差一点，而是看不到后面什么时候会好起来。
医生说前面这一步走得艰难一点也正常，因为身体刚好起来的时候本来就没那么有力，后面还是得一天一天慢慢来。
老师让大家写那场旅程为什么艰难，不只是想让人说路远，而是想让大家看见后面每一步都不轻松。

example_translations.translation: Those days were very difficult at first, but when the old man looked back later, he said that the hardest part was not eating a little worse, but not being able to see when things would get better later on.

The doctor said it was normal for this step ahead to feel somewhat hard, because when the body has only just begun to recover, it is naturally not very strong, and later everything still has to proceed day by day.
The teacher asked everyone to write about why that journey was difficult, not only to have them say the road was long, but to let them see that every step afterward was hard as well.

glosses.notes: 艰辛 means arduous and tough, often describing hardship over a long period.

examples.sentence: 母亲后来讲起自己年轻时那段很艰辛的日子，最先想到的不是前面吃了多少苦，而是后面终于一家人坐到一起的那个晚上。
老师说这条路为什么显得艰辛，不只是因为走得远，也是因为前面每一次快想停下的时候，后面都还得自己再劝自己一次。
节目里那位老人回顾过去的时候一直没提高声音，可是大家还是听出来了，那些年真正艰辛的地方并不是外面看到的那一点苦。

example_translations.translation: When Mother later spoke about those arduous days in her youth, the first thing she thought of was not how much suffering came earlier, but the evening later when the whole family finally sat together.
The teacher said that what made this road feel tough was not only that it was long, but also that every time one nearly wanted to stop earlier, one still had to persuade oneself again later.

The old man in the program never raised his voice while looking back on the past, yet everyone could still hear that what had truly been arduous in those years was not merely the little bit of hardship visible from the outside.

glosses.notes: 坚硬 means hard and solid to the touch, not easy to bend or break.

examples.sentence: 孩子一脚碰到前面那块坚硬的石头以后，马上就站住了，因为他前面只觉得路不好走，没想到下面会这么硬。
医生说外面那层看起来虽然已经好一点，可是里面还没有完全长好，所以现在一碰到坚硬的地方还是会疼。
老师把那块东西拿给大家摸的时候说，真正难画的不是它有多大，而是怎么让看的人一眼就觉得它很坚硬。

example_translations.translation: After the child’s foot hit that hard stone ahead, he stopped at once, because earlier he had only thought the road was hard to walk on and had not expected the ground below to be so solid.
The doctor said that although the outer layer looked a little better already, the inside had not fully healed, so now it still hurts when it touches something solid.
When the teacher handed that object around for everyone to touch, she said the real difficulty in drawing it was not its size, but how to make viewers feel at a glance that it was hard and solid.

glosses.notes: 兼职 means to hold a part-time job or to work in more than one position at the same time.

examples.sentence: 他白天上课，晚上还得去兼职，所以前面常常刚做完学校的事，后面就得马上往店里赶，一点空都没有。
母亲后来知道孩子在外面找了一个兼职以后，没有先生气，而是先问清楚前面会不会影响上课，再决定后面要不要同意。
经理说自己年轻时也兼职过，所以一看见那个孩子前面站得都快睡着了，就知道他这几天一定累得不轻。

example_translations.translation: He attends classes during the day and still has to work part-time at night, so often as soon as he finishes school matters earlier, he has to hurry straight to the shop later without a moment to spare.

After Mother later found out that the child had found a part-time job outside, she did not get angry first, but asked clearly whether it would affect classes earlier before deciding later whether to agree.

The manager said that he had also worked part-time when he was young, so the moment he saw that child standing there earlier as if about to fall asleep, he knew the child must have been extremely tired these past few days.
